name: Port Manager
description: See which process is using a port, stop it, and check whether remote ports are reachable
help: Lists every TCP port that is listening and every bound UDP port on this machine, together with the owning process, its user and memory.
Search by port, PID, process name, address or command line. Turn on connections to also see established TCP connections.
“Local only” ports listen on 127.0.0.1 or ::1 and cannot be reached from other devices; “All interfaces” ports are reachable from your network.
Stopping a process asks it to exit first; choose force to kill it immediately. Some system processes need administrator rights and may not be listed with a name.
The remote check tries a TCP connection to each port, for example 80,443,8000-8010 (up to 1024 ports).
